node.title: The Reactor is a storage node for documents and files that supports multiple storage adapters.
Operations are stored per (documentId, scope, branch) triple, and scope and branch live in OperationContext rather than on the operation
A Reactor is a library, not a service: it stores and syncs documents while a host application like Switchboard exposes the API
A drive is itself a document of type powerhouse/document-drive containing a list of child documents, hosted by a reactor node
